# Explore With Lora

> > Travel guides and resources for pet-friendly adventures, digital nomad lifestyle, and sustainable exploration across Mexico, Central America, and beyond.

Explore With Lora is a travel blog by Lora featuring comprehensive guides for traveling internationally with dogs, digital nomad destinations, and eco-conscious adventures. The site specializes in pet travel logistics, destination guides for Mexico and Central America, and practical resources for remote workers who want to explore the world with their pets.

## Key Topics

- International dog travel
- Pet travel documentation and requirements
- Digital nomad lifestyle with pets
- Mexico travel guides
- Costa Rica adventures
- Central America destinations
- Airline pet policies
- Rabies vaccination and border crossing
- Remote work and travel
- Sustainable and eco-conscious tourism
- Wildlife and nature experiences
- Caribbean coast destinations
- Travel blogger resources

## Traveling With Dogs

- [How to Travel With a Dog Internationally](https://www.explorewithlora.com/how-to-travel-with-a-dog-internationally): International dog travel guide: vaccines, permits, airlines, timelines
- [Traveling With a Dog to Mexico: The Ultimate Guide](https://www.explorewithlora.com/traveling-with-a-dog-to-mexico): Complete guide for traveling to Mexico with dogs: entry rules & tips
- [Airlines That Allow Dogs in Cabin in Canada](https://www.explorewithlora.com/airlines-that-allow-dogs-in-cabin-canada): Canadian airlines allowing dogs in cabin: policies, fees, requirements

## Digital Nomad Guides

- [Can You Be a Digital Nomad With a Dog?](https://www.explorewithlora.com/digital-nomad-with-dog): Digital nomad lifestyle with dogs: pros, cons, and travel tips
- [Best Places To Be a Digital Nomad in Spain](https://www.explorewithlora.com/digital-nomad-in-spain): Digital nomad destinations in Spain: visa requirements and locations

## Mexico and Central America

- [Best Guanajuato State Tours Immersed in Nature](https://www.explorewithlora.com/guanajuato-state-tours): Eco-conscious Guanajuato tours: sustainable adventures in Mexico
- [Ultimate Guide to Sunday Funday in San Juan Del Sur Nicaragua](https://www.explorewithlora.com/sunday-funday-nicaragua): Guide to Sunday Funday pool party in San Juan Del Sur, Nicaragua

## Costa Rica Adventures

- [Costa Rica Wildlife Guide: Mammals, Birds, and Reptiles](https://www.explorewithlora.com/costa-rica-mammals): Costa Rica wildlife guide: mammals, birds, reptiles in national parks
- [Fun Things to do in Puerto Viejo Costa Rica](https://www.explorewithlora.com/things-to-do-in-puerto-viejo): Puerto Viejo Costa Rica guide: Caribbean beaches, surfing, activities
- [The Best Cano Island Diving and Snorkeling Tours](https://www.explorewithlora.com/cano-island-diving): Cano Island diving tours: Costa Rica marine life and shark encounters

## Destination Guides

- [Fun Things To Do in Toronto in Summer 2023](https://www.explorewithlora.com/fun-things-to-do-in-toronto-summer): Toronto summer bucket list: festivals, attractions, and road trips
- [Fun Things to do in Central Newfoundland](https://www.explorewithlora.com/adventures-newfoundland): Central Newfoundland adventures: kayaking, whale watching, icebergs
- [This Shizuoka Itinerary Takes You Beyond Mount Fuji](https://www.explorewithlora.com/shizuoka-itinerary): One-week Shizuoka itinerary: Mount Fuji, culture, sustainable travel
